d: Earthly hall within a castle of the Ptolemies. Family of Nello.
Apartments of Pia. Two side doors: the one on the right leads to the bedroom: another door at the bottom, behind which a verone, which answers on the garden. Bice, and Lamberto.
Underground horrible, just illuminated by a dark lamp: deep down an iron rake, behind which a man of arms walks.
Apartments in Pia, as in the scene V.Nello, Ghino, Bice, and Scudieri di Nello from the door to the left. A fired double over a table: the door of the verone is closed.
Pia, Bice, and sayings. Bice retires by the door to the left.
Serve with others, Ubaldo, Familiari, Damigelle, Armmen, Bice, and sayings.
Variant written for the performance of Senigallia (1837) with concert by Napoli (1838).
Camping of the Florentine army, near a gate of the suburb of Siena. Choir of Warriors, Rodrigo and Lamberto.
Old gun room in the castle of the Maremma; entrance to the bottom, two doors on the sides: one of them puts at the prison of Pia. Ghino, and Ubaldo.

Atrium of a hermitage: in the cross of the intercolunnium you can see the uncultivated lands of the Maremma. - The night is late, the sky is very black, and rages a terrible storm. Piero, and other Romites.
Prison of Pia. On the top a window with iron bars: staircase at the bottom, at the top of which is the door.
Rodrigo followed by a Schiera of Guelphs, and sayings.
